$comment: Which canon file governs which path. Read by the canon plugin's require-canon hook, by
/canon:canon and by /canon:review. Editing this file is how the map changes; none of
Each key is a file in docs/canon/. Each value is a list of patterns. A pattern ending in /
matches any path under that directory. A pattern containing / but not ending in one matches
that exact repo-relative path. A pattern with no / matches any file with that basename,
wherever it sits. Nothing here is a glob, on purpose: a map that needs a glob engine to
predict is a map nobody edits.
A path has exactly one owner. That keeps the hook's message short enough to act on.
A path that is deliberately ungoverned gets a line here saying why, so its absence reads as
a decision rather than an oversight.
